skills.name: growth-ops
skills.description: Use when you need free distribution for a site or project — search-engine indexing, directory submissions, verification emails, an overnight unattended submission run, or a judgement call on whether a channel is worth retrying.

skills.name: mail-assistant
skills.description: Use when asked to check the inbox or triage incoming mail — read-only listing, four-class sorting, drafted replies that mirror the sender's language and never send themselves, activation-link verification, and a to-do report for the owner.

skills.name: site-ops
skills.description: Use when operating a static site on an edge platform — DNS changes, custom-domain binding, scoped API tokens, cache purge, a locked deploy chain — or when diagnosing a deploy, header, or ghost-path failure.

skills.name: analysis-pipeline
skills.description: Use when turning a submitted request for a deep website or project analysis into a publishable long-form article — worthiness scorecard, evidence gathering, anti-poisoning rules, bilingual draft, lint and a static publish package.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes

skills.name: webapp-testing
skills.description: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright. Supports verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing browser screenshots, and viewing browser logs.

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code

skills.name: voice-reply
skills.description: Use when the user explicitly asks for a spoken reply — turning an answer into a short voice clip (free TTS), always attaching the text, transcribing inbound voice notes before processing, and degrading to plain text when synthesis fails.

skills.name: research-brief
skills.description: Use when asked to verify a claim, compare options, shortlist or select a tool, summarise a topic, or draft a reply from research — a three-tier report pipeline with multi-source verification, mandatory citations and three-colour annotation.

skills.name: binance-read-only
skills.description: Use when reading Binance balances, orders or market data, creating a least-privilege USER_DATA API key, or diagnosing Binance auth — orders only via the console approval gate.

skills.name: kraken-read-only
skills.description: Use when reading Kraken balances, orders or market data, creating a least-privilege Query-only Kraken API key, or diagnosing Kraken auth (nonce, API-Sign) — never for trading.

skills.name: okx-read-only
skills.description: Use when reading OKX balances, orders or market data, creating a least-privilege read-only OKX API key, or diagnosing OKX auth (passphrase, timestamp skew) — never for trading.
